digest.component_or_area: plan-review verdict emission and workflow failure classification
propositions: A stale or malformed installed rebar build raises CriteriaError during criteria assembly, but the workflow interpreter records only a string representation, losing typed exception identity.
Gate dispatch routes every unrecovered workflow failure through the generic degraded builder, which unconditionally stamps llm_unavailable=true regardless of whether any LLM frame executed.
Config/criteria parse failures must be routed to a dedicated config-fault verdict path before generic LLM degradation, preserving deterministic findings without the affirmative llm_unavailable label.

The config-fault diagnostic must explicitly name the running installed rebar build as the suspect and direct operators to use the repository checkout build instead of troubleshooting provider credentials.
Genuine LLMUnavailableError preflight and mid-run failures must remain byte-for-byte unchanged, and deterministic blockers must not be masked by config-fault indeterminate verdicts.
